segments.text: And the first point I want to make is for new biologic products, we always demand safety, safety, safety.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: There are safety standards for the roof over your head right now.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: There's safety standards for the clothes that you're wearing, for the cars that you're driving.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Safety standards.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Here we are today, embarked on the biggest mass public health vaccination program in the history of the world, and we haven't seen a single standard applied for safety.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: So what we have is we have a situation where we needed a report card once a month.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: We have three products, Pfizer, Moderna, and J&J.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: They are extremely unlikely to be the same.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: In fact, I tell you, they're not the same.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Moderna's 100 micrograms, Pfizer's 30 micrograms per shot, Johnson & Johnson is adenoviral particle numbers given.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: They are not the same.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: So any person or any group that says, here, just take a vaccine, any vaccine, you should be asking yourself, wait a minute, there's three products.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Don't I get to choose?
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Doesn't it matter which one's better?
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Doesn't it matter which one's safer?
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: How come nobody's asking that question?
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Where has been the monthly press briefings
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: from our stakeholders.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Now, the CDC and FDA are running the program.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: They work for us.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: We don't work for them.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: They owed us a monthly press briefing and a monthly comprehensive safety and efficacy report.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: They have all the data.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: They have all the data.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: I recognize lots of you took the vaccine.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: You signed consent to have your data go to the central center.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: They know it all.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: But we have not had a single report card, nothing.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: We're nearly a year into the program and all we've been told is take a vaccine, any vaccine, no report on safety and efficacy.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: We have more safety reports on building inspections, on inspections of apartments.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: You have more safety reports on your car inspection.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: And here we are taking an injection of a novel biologic agent that is supposed to be linked to our freedoms and absolutely no safety report.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
